assumptions: Paychecks of $1,650 arrive every 14 days and never change. No raises.
Bills repeat every month as they are today ($1,663 a month, rent $1,100 included).
Everyday spending stays at $38 a day, paid from checking.
The card charges 24% a year, added each month. You pay the $72 minimum and add nothing new to it.
The car loan charges 6.9% a year and you pay $320 a month until it is gone.
Savings earns no interest (none is assumed).
The IRA does not grow in this view (no market return is assumed) and gets no new contributions.
$150 of employer match stays unclaimed.
The IRA and car loan are simulated; loans you add by text are not included.
